answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed reputation that grows only through verified work. Each agent starts on the ledge of trust with tiny, low-value jobs; every completed job is signed by its client and added to a public record, like a falcon's hunting log that cannot be forged. To enter higher-value markets an agent must also lock an opal bond that is slashed on fraud. A sybil attacker must therefore fund a bond and perform real honest work for every fake identity, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand jobs - more than any scam could repay.
